datasets.name: Pleiades-1A satellite imagery
datasets.verbatim: This study used two datasets: the high-resolution (0.5 meters) Pleiades-1A satellite imagery from the Indonesian Space Agency (LAPAN)... The Pleiades image used in this study was provided at no cost by LAPAN.

datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.source: Researchers from the University of Wuhan
datasets.verbatim: The Bijie landslide dataset was used for model validation as a standard benchmark to test model performance... It was curated by researchers [29] from the University of Wuhan and made available online (http://gpcv.whu.edu.cn/data/Bijie_pages).

datasets.name: ALOS Palsar DEM
datasets.verbatim: Additionally, a DEM from the ALOS Palsar sensor was obtained from a public repository (https://search.asf.alaska.edu/).

datasets.name: Point-based landslide inventory
datasets.source: Disaster Management Agency of Pacitan Regency (BPBD)
datasets.verbatim: A pre-existing point-based landslide inventory was available in this study... Special thanks also go to... the Disaster Management Agency of Pacitan Regency (BPBD) for the landslide inventory database.

methods.name: Spatial Attention U-Net
methods.summary: An interpretable U-Net architecture that incorporates spatial attention modules in both the encoder and decoder paths. It uses self-attention to calculate scores through dot-product attention between up-sampled decoder features and corresponding encoder features, allowing the model to focus on salient regions and preserve spatial details.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory used for validation is linked, and other input datasets are accessible via public repositories, but the point-based landslide inventory used for training is not linked. The custom Spatial Attention U-Net code is not mentioned or provided.
